LESSON: QUALITIES OF ENLIGHTENED BEINGS

Grade: Grade 1
Subject: HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Manifestations
Topic 3.1: Qualities Of Enlightened Beings

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Qualities Of Enlightened Beings. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify the names of the Enlightened Beings from the Pictures to build confidence 80
2. appreciate the qualities of the Enlightened Beings as loving and 3.2 Belief in paramatma the Enlightened Beings (4 lessons) in Paramatma.

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. identify the names of the Enlightened Beings from the Pictures to build confidence 80
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to identify the names of the Enlightened Beings from the Pictures to build confidence 80. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

2. appreciate the qualities of the Enlightened Beings as loving and 3.2 Belief in paramatma the Enlightened Beings (4 lessons) in Paramatma.
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to appreciate the qualities of the Enlightened Beings as loving and 3.2 Belief in paramatma the Enlightened Beings (4 lessons) in Paramatma. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Name one place of worship in your community and say how people show respect there.

Example 2: Practise sitting quietly for a short prayer or reflection.

Example 3: Tell your parent one good habit you learned from this lesson.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about Qualities Of Enlightened Beings.
2. Explain Qualities Of Enlightened Beings to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Qualities Of Enlightened Beings.
4. Show that you can: identify the names of the Enlightened Beings from the Pictures to build confidence 80
5. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Qualities Of Enlightened Beings. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: Why is Qualities Of Enlightened Beings important to you?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 8: REMEMBER

1. identify the names of the Enlightened Beings from the Pictures to build confidence 80
2. appreciate the qualities of the Enlightened Beings as loving and 3.2 Belief in paramatma the Enlightened Beings (4 lessons) in Paramatma.

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Learner lesson
